(() => {
  try {
    const motionQuery = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    if (motionQuery && motionQuery.matches) return;

    const root = document.documentElement;
    let expired = false;
    let timer;

    const failOpen = () => {
      if (!expired || document.visibilityState !== "visible") return;
      cleanup();
      root.classList.remove("home-hero-prepared");
    };

    const cleanup = () => {
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", failOpen);
    };

    root.classList.add("home-hero-prepared");
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", failOpen);
    timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      expired = true;
      failOpen();
    }, 2000);
    window.homeHeroState = { cleanup, started: false };
  } catch (_) {
    document.documentElement.classList.remove("home-hero-prepared");
  }
})();
